description.en: Grows from zero with a slight overshoot.
description.id: Membesar dari nol dengan sedikit pantulan.

description.en: Shakes left and right, then settles.

description.id: Berayun kiri-kanan seperti bandul (anchor = titik gantung).

description.en: Slowly grows and dims, like breathing.
description.id: Membesar dan meredup pelan seperti bernapas.

description.en: Blinks briefly at a regular interval.
Shrinks, grows while wobbling, then settles.
description.id: Mengecil, membesar sambil bergoyang, lalu kembali.

description.en: Smooth random motion (seeded, identical on every render).
description.id: Gerak acak halus (ber-seed, hasil sama setiap render).

description.en: Stretches and snaps back like rubber.
Comes in large and shrinks to size.
description.id: Datang dari besar lalu mengecil ke ukurannya.

description.en: Flips in around the vertical axis (3D look).
Flips in around the horizontal axis (3D look).
Pops up with a slight overshoot.
Swings in and settles (put the anchor on the hinge).
description.id: Berayun masuk lalu tenang (taruh anchor di titik engsel).

description.en: Comes in stretched and springs into shape.
description.id: Masuk memanjang lalu memantul ke bentuknya.

description.en: Flips out around the vertical axis.
Flips out around the horizontal axis.
Sinks a little, shrinks and fades.
Flattens to a line and disappears.
Moves in a circle, starting and ending at its own position.
description.id: Bergerak melingkar, mulai dan berakhir di posisinya.

description.en: Hops in place with squash and stretch.
description.id: Melompat di tempat dengan squash & stretch.

description.en: Drifts slowly and irregularly, still seamless when looped.
description.id: Melayang pelan tak beraturan, tetap mulus saat diulang.

description.en: Hovers up and down with a slight tilt.
Rotates in steps like a clock hand.
description.id: Berputar per langkah seperti jarum jam.

description.en: Shakes its head, like saying no.
Grows for a moment, then returns.
Swings a few times, then rests (anchor = pivot).
description.id: Berayun beberapa kali lalu diam (anchor = titik gantung).

description.en: Strokes draw on from the start of each path to its end (needs a stroke).
description.id: Garis tergambar dari awal sampai akhir path (butuh stroke).

description.en: Strokes draw out from the middle of each path to both ends (needs a stroke).
description.id: Garis tergambar dari tengah path ke kedua ujung (butuh stroke).

description.en: Strokes erase from the start of each path to its end (needs a stroke).
description.id: Garis terhapus dari awal sampai akhir path (butuh stroke).

description.en: A segment of the stroke travels along each path continuously (needs a stroke).
description.id: Potongan garis berjalan mengelilingi path terus-menerus (butuh stroke).

description.en: Comes into focus from a blur.
Blurs for a moment, then sharpens again.
Leans to one side, then springs back.
description.id: Condong ke samping lalu kembali dengan pantulan.

description.en: Sways from side to side like in the wind.
description.id: Bergoyang miring kiri-kanan seperti tertiup angin.

description.en: Opens from a small circle in the middle.
description.id: Terbuka dari lingkaran kecil di tengah.

description.en: Closes to a circle in the middle.
Opens from the centre line out to both sides.
description.id: Terbuka dari garis tengah ke kedua sisi.

description.en: Flashes a colour for a moment, then returns.
A colour pulses in and out continuously.
Jumps twice, the second one lower.
description.id: Melompat dua kali, yang kedua lebih rendah.
